sentences.text:
Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o  India, praying this Court to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing th  Respondents to conduct an investigation into the irregularities in  procurement of food for the COVID19 patients under care and the  medical staff who are attending them and to procure all such foods   following the procedures prescribed unde  Transparency in Tenders Act, 1998.
 For Petitioner : Mr.S.Vanchinathan

For Respondents : Mr.J.Ashok,
 Additional Govern  ORDER [Order of the Court was made by S.M.SUBRAMANIAM, J.]
The cause arose for the filing of the present writ petition does not exist as of now, as nothing survives in the writ petition.
Therefore, this Writ Petition stands disposed of as infructuous.
There shall be no order as to costs.

[S.M.S., J.] 
 J.]
